title: Kerr-de Sitter Black Holes: Quantum Aspects and Cosmic Censorship Conjecture
summary: In this article, we test the validity of the weak cosmic censorship conjecture (wCCC) in the background of a quantum Kerr-de Sitter (qKdS) black hole, incorporating exact backreaction from quantum matter fields. Using a test particle approach, we analyze whether an extremal qKdS black hole can be over-extremized to expose a naked singularity. Our results indicate that the black hole remains stable against horizon-destroying processes induced by infalling matter.
